programme.title: Big Cat Country S1 Ep01
programme.desc: When the all-female Hollywood pride encounters the Nomads, a new pride of rival males, they may have found the answer to their mating dry spell.

programme.title: Big Cat Country S1 Ep02
programme.desc: The Hollywood pride reels after the Nomad's brutal attack on their leader, Ava, leaves her desperately weak and unable to hunt. To add to her woes, her hungry pride start rejecting her.

programme.title: Big Cat Country S1 Ep03
programme.desc: The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK pride's territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs.

programme.title: Big Cat Country S1 Ep04
programme.desc: After the dry season lowers the waters, siblings Kimba and Maya risk crossing the river to search for their parents. They run the gauntlet of the densest populations of crocs and hippos in Africa.

programme.title: Big Cat Country S1 Ep05
programme.desc: During the last few weeks of the dry season, the prides stick close to the only available water in the river. But in Luangwa, that proximity spells danger.

programme.title: Big Cat Country S1 Ep06
programme.desc: The all-female Hollywood pride have been in exile after being attacked by the four Nomad brothers. But their leader, Ava, decides to lead her family south.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas S2 Ep09
programme.desc: From turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, our planet is a battleground as animals go head to head, in Battle of the Alphas.

programme.desc: A look behind the scenes at the Lewa Wildlife Conservancy in Kenya and the Northern Rangelands Trust's conservation work.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands With Eoin Warner S1 Ep01
programme.desc: Begin on Rathlin, where flightless guillemot chicks take a leap of faith and golden hares welcome the dawn. Head to Tory to see basking sharks, dolphins, and the endangered corncrake's dance of love.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands With Eoin Warner S1 Ep02
programme.desc: Continue the odyssey along Ireland's west coast. Spy on the love affairs of grey seals in the Inishkea Islands and ply Connemara's turquoise waters.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands With Eoin Warner S1 Ep03
programme.desc: Learn how Arctic terns negotiate a 50,000-mile-a-year commute to summer in Kerry's Maharee Islands. Go whale-watching off Brandon Head, then witness Ireland's greatest wildlife spectacle.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2 Ep02
programme.desc: Their ancestors were the first vertebrates to colonise dry land and they inhabit every continent except Antarctica, but their world is rapidly changing.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2 Ep03
programme.desc: Once abundant on the continent, elephant populations have been drastically reduced by hunting for ivory and meat in the last 200 years.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2 Ep04
programme.desc: Surviving in the African savanna requires wit and guile, especially for two of its hunters: African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2 Ep05
programme.desc: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial.

programme.desc: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africa's amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It's a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1 Ep01
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1 Ep02
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1 Ep04
programme.desc: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team.

programme.desc: Travel to the ends of Australia's shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between the sharks.

programme.title: Super Shark Highway S1 Ep06
programme.desc: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team.
